name: coffelab
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to coffelab in Innsbruck – your specialty coffee haven in the heart of Tirol!**

Indulge in the finest **Espresso**, **Flat White**, or **Cappuccino** crafted with passion by our baristas. Whether you're a coffee connoisseur or just looking for a cozy break, our **Third Wave Coffee** experience awaits you.

📍 **Find us** in the vibrant center of Innsbruck, where every sip tells a story of **Tirol’s** charm.

☕ **Try our daily specials** – from creamy **Latte Macchiato** to bold **Americano** and seasonal creations.

🍰 **Pair your coffee** with one of our homemade pastries, like fluffy **Kaiserschmarrn** or rich **Apfelstrudel**.

💡 **Work or relax** in our stylish lounge with free Wi-Fi and a view of Innsbruck’s lively streets.

🕒 **Open daily** – your perfect coffee escape in the Alps!

#coffelab #Innsbruck #Tirol #SpecialtyCoffee #KaffeeLiebe
